title: A delayed flight
instructions: Jan havalimanında uçuşunu soruyor. Uçuşla ilgili değişen bilgilere dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: jan
script.text: Excuse me. Is the flight to Madrid on time?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No, I'm sorry. It's late. It leaves at two thirty now, not at one.

script.speaker: jan
script.text: Oh no. That's an hour and a half late!

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, I'm very sorry. Here is a ticket for a free lunch.

script.speaker: jan
script.text: Thank you. Where can I eat?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: At the restaurant upstairs, next to gate eleven.

script.speaker: jan
script.text: And which gate is the flight?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Gate seven. But please check the screens. It can change.

questions.evidence: Is the flight to Madrid on time?

questions.prompt: What time does the flight leave now?
questions.feedback: Uçuş artık iki buçukta (two thirty), saat birde değil.
questions.evidence: It leaves at two thirty now, not at one.

questions.feedback: Birden iki buçuğa: bir buçuk saat geç.
questions.evidence: That's an hour and a half late!

options: a ticket for a free lunch
questions.feedback: Ücretsiz öğle yemeği fişi (a ticket for a free lunch) alıyor.
questions.evidence: Here is a ticket for a free lunch.

questions.feedback: Uçuş yedi numaralı kapıdan (gate seven). On bir restoranın yanındaki kapı.
